description: This file defines the S3EncryptionClient class, a deprecated PHP wrapper for AWS S3 client that adds encryption and decryption functionality to S3 object operations. It provides methods for asynchronously and synchronously putting and getting encrypted objects, utilizing various cryptographic strategies.

classes.name: Aws\S3\Crypto\S3EncryptionClient
classes.description: A deprecated wrapper class that adds encryption and decryption capabilities to the S3Client for object upload/download operations, supporting async and sync methods.

methods.name: putObjectAsync
methods.description: Encrypts the 'Body' of the provided arguments and uploads it asynchronously to S3, returning a promise.

methods.name: putObject
methods.description: Encrypts and uploads an object to S3 synchronously.

methods.name: getObjectAsync
methods.description: Retrieves and decrypts an object from S3 asynchronously, returning a promise.

methods.name: getObject
methods.description: Retrieves and decrypts an object from S3 synchronously.
